title: QA run · release-18.3.0-w3-tier1-a (73/73) · c4c515ad · 2026-10-29 · 59 PASS / 14 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcScm27Q3R5mkYLPWdB
Part of #27377 (wave 3, W3-C2a)

Selector `release-18.3.0-w3-tier1-a`: Tier 1 half A of the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, the 73 runnable items that carry `automated.ref` in access-security, ai, api-backend, approvals, attachments-storage, automation and cli. Release-candidate rerun (SKILL §5 trigger 1). Every item has a verdict: **59 PASS / 14 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN**. No item is `planned`.

## Environment fingerprint

- Subject: framework `c4c515ad3cc342043a2b81b5a06a5793f79a23e8` (detached, never followed main). The Console was built in-repo from that same commit (`ui/`): `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (114/114 tasks), then `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (cache hit plus copy). `pnpm build` alone left `packages/console/dist` absent, so the first boots answered `/_console` 503 until `console:build` ran. Browser legs were re-driven after that.
- Node v22.22.0, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright chromium from `/opt/pw-browsers`.
- App: `examples/app-showcase`. Canonical boot per area, each with its own port and file DB: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=/tmp/w3c2a/AREA/uploads setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p PORT -d file:/tmp/w3c2a/AREA/data.db`. Ports: cli 41411, ai 41412, approvals 41413, api-backend 41414, attachments-storage 41415, automation 41416 (plus a Vite console dev server on 41496 for the live Playwright spec), access-security 41417.
- Extra boots: a walled `isolated` boot for access-security (OS_TENANCY_POSTURE, OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL, OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY); a second automation boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1` from a scratch copy of the showcase; scratch apps and copies for cli under /tmp/w3c2a/cli; a local registry with no upstream for the cli scaffold pre-release leg (108 tarballs packed from c4c515ad).
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the showcase demo personas, and members minted by invite then sign-up (RUNNER environment facts).
- Times: 2026-10-29 04:20Z to 05:30Z.
- Execution: one coordinating runner plus seven per-area runner subagents in parallel, each with its own port and DB. Their verdicts were checked against their evidence files and transcripts before this record was written. One subagent's self-reported minutes were inconsistent with its wall clock, so the time figures below use wall clock where they disagree.

## Scope: selector and the revision each verdict is valid for

Revisions as `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs` reports them at c4c515ad. All 73 match the area files.

## Tier 1 pins: one vitest invocation per area per package

62 invocations at `--maxWorkers=1` covered every pinned test file the 73 refs name: **279 file runs, 7488 passed, 0 failed, 3 skipped**. The 3 skips are by design: two `rls-multitenant` cases and one cross-tenant matrix case. cli `*.e2e.test.*` ran separately under `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`. The ui jsdom suites ran from the `ui/` root (the objectui vitest guard refuses a package-dir run).

| area | invocations | file runs | passed |
|---|---|---|---|
| access-security | 19 | 96 | 2249 |
| ai | 6 | 18 | 293 |
| api-backend | 7 | 51 | 1783 |
| approvals | 5 | 18 | 545 |
| attachments-storage | 6 | 27 | 667 |
| automation | 12 | 32 | 1076 |
| cli | 7 | 37 | 875 |

Live Playwright specs:
- `ui/e2e/live/screen-flow.spec.ts` was run against the automation boot. 1 passed on the third attempt, after two runs that failed while the console dev server was still cold. Run 2 had completed server-side.
- `ui/e2e/live/grid-file-upload.spec.ts` was not run. That item was driven by hand against the built console instead.

Per RUNNER rule 6, each clause names the layer its pin drives. A pin below the clause's oracle scored the clause `partial` unless its live leg was driven on the area's boot.

## Reproduction rules

None: 0 clause `fail`. The product defects found by off-clause probes are extracted as their own cards, each with its own reproduction. They are listed in the close-out comment.

## Derived item verdicts

- **PASS (59):** every item not listed below.
- **PARTIAL (14)**, each with the clause that kept it below PASS:
  - access-security.rls-both-sides: A5. The D11 spot-check needs the maintainer-held write-up (#22017).
  - access-security.crud-permission-matrix: A5. Guest create-without-read is not observable on a stock boot (#23267).
  - ai.mcp-oauth-private-host-transport: A0 blocked(fixture), the host holds no RFC1918 or link-local address. A2 partial, its private-address leg is missing.
  - api-backend.action-activation-door-contract: A4. The 503 arm for a degraded metadata plane has no stock door and no pin.
  - approvals.email-action-token-door: A0, A1, A3 and A4 are below the oracle (no pin and no stock door mints an action token). A5 blocked(fixture).
  - approvals.status-mirror-field: A2. The user-less cascade refusal on an SLA auto-decision has service-unit evidence only.
  - approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility: A2, no non-admin persona holds read on `sys_approval_request` on the stock showcase. A3, flipping the reader flag needs an object metadata write.
  - attachments-storage.read-inherits-parent-rls: A3. The bounded-probe half is reachable only through engine and unit pins.
  - attachments-storage.sys-file-status-pipeline: A2. The deleted-row-with-live-holder half has no live door.
  - attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap: A1. The failed byte-delete veto has unit evidence only.
  - attachments-storage.upload-session-abort: A3, the warning text is asserted only on a mock logger. A4, `failed` is reachable only through a test seam.
  - automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked: A0 and A1. No stock object has an `internal: true` field, so the internal-key-absent half rests on the in-process pin.
  - automation.setup-packaged-automation-board: A5. A plain member cannot open the Setup app, so the member's refusal is seen only as the server body.
  - cli.organization-ownership-ceremony: A4. The drop gate was driven on the 18.0.0-next.5 dump, because no v17-shaped DB was provisioned.

Fixture gaps and partial-coverage gaps are parked on #27377. The anchor comment lists them.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 48 agent-minutes in total, after the clauses had verdicts, on the same boots and personas:
- access-security, ~6 min: the explain and share-link doors as admin, a plain member and the auditor; empty, unknown and missing ids. No finding. One cosmetic observation: the anonymous share page shows raw owner and organization ids.
- ai, ~2 min, short of budget: MCP HTTP auth with empty, unknown and revoked keys; `get_record` with an empty id; `validate_expression` with empty or blank input and a bad site; `prompts/get` with an empty name. **Finding:** `validate_expression` answers ok:true for a blank expression (extracted).
- api-backend, ~10 min: list and query doors with boundary `$top`, `$skip`, `$orderby`, `$filter`, `$select` and `$expand` values; bulk doors as admin and two members. No defect.
- approvals, ~10 min: the act page (no token, empty token, oversized token, a script token that came back escaped), the reply door, and member access to others' requests. No defect. One hardening note: the write routes answer 403 for an existing request and 404 for an unknown id. It is not exploitable, because it needs a signed-in member and reveals only whether a random UUID exists.
- attachments-storage, ~5 min: `acl` flips by other personas; unknown, empty and malformed ids on download and complete; size and filename edges on presign; chunk-index edges; attaching another user's file. **Findings:** two defects in chunk-index and presign-size validation (extracted), and one more:
  - attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides · observed beside the clauses · security finding — detail withheld, fix dispatched
- automation, ~8 min: run, screen and resume doors with unknown ids and bad inputs; toggle and clone edge cases; the action activation doors. **Findings:** cloning a packaged flow records no actor, and `/automation/_status` reports a time_relative flow as bound when its trigger refused it (both extracted).
- cli, ~7 min: `meta register` with a blank package, `explain` boundaries, `migrate meta --from` boundaries, ceremony re-plan and re-apply. No defect. One low-severity observation: `--from 99` warns but is not refused.

## Time: environment prep vs testing

- Environment prep: cold install plus `pnpm build` took 13 min wall (04:21Z to 04:34Z), plus 1 min of `console:build`, plus about 39 agent-minutes of per-area boots and fixtures.
- Testing: the pin batches took 26 min wall (04:34Z to 05:00Z), plus about 167 agent-minutes of clause scoring and live legs, plus about 48 agent-minutes of probes.
- Ratio: about 1 to 4.5. Wall clock for the whole run was about 70 min.
